newsitem.title: UK: First Choice summer 97 bookings up 42 pct.
newsitem.headline: First Choice summer 97 bookings up 42 pct.

text.p: UK tour operator First Choice Holidays Plc said on Wednesday that current trading was strong with bookings for the UK summer 1997 programme 42 percent ahead of last year.

First Choice, which posted a full-year pre-tax profit of 10 million stg against 1.3 million in 1995, said it was encouraged by the continuing recovery in the market, including the Winter 1996/97 programme in the UK and the Summer 97 programme.

First Choice said it had sold 25 percent of its 1997 full season capacity compared to 17 percent this time last year. It said its cautious approach to capacity planning would ensure it was well placed to achieve satisfactory returns.
"Our focus will continue to be on improving the profitability of the Group's core trading activities," chairman Michael Julien said in a statement.

"I am confident that we have a management team in place across the Group with the necessary blend of industry experience and business skills to build upon the sound platform which has been created following the restructuring and rebranding of the entire Group," he added.
